name: orchestration-kit
description: Shared claimable agent board + independent verification + worktree reconcile workflow for running multiple Claude Code sessions (each dispatching parallel worktree subagents) on one repo without collisions. Ships the board template, the workflow skills, the verifier agent, a CLAUDE.md starter, and distilled cross-project lessons. v0.3.0 adds the orchestrate loop and the bootstrap-project super-init.
